category_definitions.saved_replay_with_callbacks: Stack contains PersistedSummaryReplayKt.replayPersistedSummaries and no asynchronous current-delivery frame.
category_definitions.ordinary_statement_with_callbacks: Stack contains RunMethodAnalyzer.runStatement, outside the previous categories.
category_definitions.direct_call_processing_outside_saved_rep: Stack contains RunMethodCallServices.process, but not saved replay or asynchronous current delivery. Can include call-entry/bypass stages, immediate current replay and their callbacks. It cannot distinguish ALIASES versus BIND_BACK versus PASS_OVER stage.kind.
limits: Samples are Java execution samples, not elapsed or total CPU shares.
Categories are disjoint by precedence; individual anchor scopes overlap.
Stirling native same-direction applyRecord anchor matches exact method name, avoiding the applyRecordView prefix.
Full sampled stacks are not truncated in these selected phases. No actual MethodKey, field-tree size, stage.kind, mark values or complete mask values are present in the samples.

causal_findings.finding: The dominant Stirling backward lane is call processing outside saved replay, not ordinary field statements or native leaf replay alone.
causal_findings.evidence: B6 direct call81.316%, saved replay15.304%, ordinary statement2.818%; B8 direct call83.939%, saved replay12.989%, ordinary statement2.611%. Most MethodEdgeStore.add samples are in the direct-call category.
causal_findings.limit: The direct category includes pre-callee and bypass call stages, but samples do not reveal stage.kind. Do not attribute all81/84% specifically to aliases.

causal_findings.finding: Backward run6/run8 execute many more call offers and allocate more per offer than adjacent forward runs.

causal_findings.finding: Reverse call plans permit convergent alias branches before callee matching and have no per-point item-set admission in production flow.
causal_findings.evidence: Forward ALIASES is after callee/rewriter and guarded. Reversal moves it before the callee, removes the guard, extends touched alias bases and adds independent PASS_OVER. Production applyStage appends every result to ArrayList and flow executes every branch, so identical images reach cleaners/callee/suffix repeatedly before authoritative post-statement deduplication.
causal_findings.why_forward_can_be_fast: A later NORMAL identity result fails forward MemoryEffect, and forward reads remove prefixes instead of growing inverse requirements. Later DEMAND forward identities can still admit aliases; this is not an all-forward suppression claim.
causal_findings.control: Width64 reverse aliases:65call finishes/2stored leaves; forward NORMAL identity:1finish/1stored leaf. Exact external control receipt is cited below.
causal_findings.project_attribution: Mechanism reproduced, but actual alias widths and duplicate stage-image ratios were not recorded.

causal_findings.finding: Inverse field-read loops create an expanding path language behind one boundary demand.
causal_findings.evidence: Production-AP control has one admitted exact-DEMAND initial and one selected exit demand. At limits1/3/5/7, raw summary leaves3/15/63/255 and processed items21/81/321/1281; forward uniform NORMAL control processes17items and has2leaves.
causal_findings.tails: Backward exact leaves occur at every depth0..L-1 (2^depth each); cut ANY leaves occur at depthL (2^L). The exact ancestor does not subsume all descendant positions.
causal_findings.why_forward_can_be_fast: A forward field read consumes a known prefix. A uniform input can retain a broad image, while reversing the same read prepends a new field to a precise requirement. C2 admission and final C5 do not restrict every interior AP.
causal_findings.project_attribution: The campaign does not capture per-cell path-language sizes. Do not claim the full model distribution exists in the actual hot method.

causal_findings.finding: Opposite-direction packed records scalarize and resume each view separately, even when results converge.
causal_findings.evidence: A normal FLOW record p.*→{ret.a.*,ret.b.*} plus one packed DEMAND actual ret.{a.h.[any],b.h.[any]}/T gives2applyRecordView calls,2caller finishes and1stored output. Forward same-direction replay invokes1applyRecord/1finish and retains2output paths. Protected and unprotected controls pass.
causal_findings.scope: Saved replay with callbacks is~15% of B6 and13% of B8 Java samples. This proven multiplier is secondary to direct reversed-plan work in the captured phases.
causal_findings.extra_source_cost: For each of L actual leaves, reversedLeavesAt enumerates all M record-conclusion leaves before prefix filtering: up to L×M leaf visits. Same-direction replay uses seen<Record> across the offer and applies its packed conclusion once.
causal_findings.project_attribution: Successful-offer and record-width counts were not captured; average matches/offer alone does not determine concentrated fanout.

causal_findings.finding: The implementation already deduplicates post-statement outputs and memoizes distinct nodes in DAG mapping.
causal_findings.evidence: completeOutput calls edges.add before CFG delivery. TaintGroup/mergeAddDelta emit ordinary/protection deltas, not the complete merged value for every mask change. TrieOps.walkNodes/mapLeaves memoize distinct input nodes.
causal_findings.limit: The7.33M B6 CFG hits therefore cannot all be identical rejected post-statement outputs. Fresh geometry/mark/protection growth and CFG successor fanout remain possible.

causal_findings.finding: Conductor run4 is dominated by current summary delivery, unlike Stirling.
causal_findings.evidence: Current-delivery category72.335%; direct call16.970%; saved replay8.475%; ordinary statement1.555%.
causal_findings.interpretation: A backward direction does not identify one universal hotspot. Retained current-input/publication products dominate Conductor, while reversed call-plan processing dominates Stirling.

source_evidence.meaning: Later forward MemoryEffect admits DEMAND or nonidentity results; reverse edges remove guards.
CallPlan.reversed extends touched alias bases and adds independent PASS_OVER identities.
Production flow walks every branch via frames; there is no global (point,PlanFact) visited set.
Each stage uses ArrayList outputs. Cleaner-local PlanFacts does not deduplicate all incoming stage facts.
Same-direction records are seen once; opposite-direction leaf views are selected individually.
Each reversedLeavesAt invocation enumerates the complete conclusion before filtering by the provided leaf.
Each accepted reverse view calls resumeCallees immediately.
resumeCallees starts the complete caller suffix for that callback.
completeOutput gates successor delivery on fresh MethodEdgeStore output.
TAINT storage constructs ordinary and protection deltas, not unconditional whole snapshots.
walkNodes memoizes each distinct node in a shared DAG.
A protected input executes a shadow AP transfer and a full AP transfer; full/partial-mask population was not measured.

native_example.code: Box dup(Box p) { Box r = new Box(); r.a=p; r.b=p; return r; }
native_example.caller_original: One complete concrete caller original I; it is unchanged through both views.
native_example.backward_bound_actual: {ret.a.h.[any]/T, ret.b.h.[any]/T}, DEMAND. This is an actual image, not an emitted MAY initial.
ordered_trace: byExit finds the same forward record for actual leaf ret.a.h. reversedLeavesAt exposes ret.a.*/FLOW→arg0.*/FLOW.
seenViews admits this view. satisfying selects ret.a.h.[any]/T. applyRecordView emits arg0.h.[any]/T DEMAND under I.
applyRecordView immediately calls resumeCallees: caller cleaning, reverse binding, field cut and emitAfter run; the first I→x.h.[any]/T is stored.
Actual leaf ret.b.h exposes the distinct view ret.b.*/FLOW→arg0.*/FLOW, which seenViews also admits.
Its selected actual yields the same arg0.h.[any]/T under I. resumeCallees executes the same suffix again.
MethodEdgeStore.add finally rejects the identical second I→x.h.[any]/T when no new protection annotation is added.
native_example.protection_variant: The control also protects only the first backward actual path. The merged final output retains protection. Ordinary fact equality alone is not a valid optimization key.
